heading: Accommodation
paragraphs:
We've booked out the whole estate for the weekend, including some rooms in a sister property a few minutes drive away. There are double bedrooms, one bedroom apartments with sofa beds and some two-bedroom apartments. Let us know in your Save the Date response what your preference is and if there are any other parties you want to share accommodation with. We will then come back to you on costings and allocate your room.

There are kitchens or kitchenettes in most of the rooms, but there is also a restaurant and bar on site, which is open to guests throughout the weekend. Shuttle buses will be provided on the wedding day to bring guests to and from the hamlets, sister accommodation and the forte.
